title: Landing page and signing in
roles: Everyone; new school owner
needs: A signed-out browser, two controlled email inboxes, and the school address from the coordinator.

cases.title: Understand the landing page
steps: Open the SchoolOs address.
Read the main heading and one feature card.
Without help, say what the app does and who it is for.
cases.expect: You can explain the main purpose. Each feature description is short; images help explain it. Record anything confusing.

cases.title: Use landing page links
steps: Open Features, Get started and Sign in.
Return and choose Set up your school.
Open Student sign in.
cases.expect: Each link opens the matching section or page. No broken links or unexpected school records appear.

cases.title: Register a school
steps: Open Register.
Enter your name, a controlled email and a new password.
Enter a new test school name and finish.
Sign out and sign back in.
cases.expect: One new school opens. You do not have to invent a school code or type a school slug.
cases.needs: Use a new test school name and unused inbox. Password: at least 8 characters, including a letter and number.

cases.title: Correct registration mistakes
steps: Try a blank required field, invalid email and mismatched passwords separately.
Try a 7-character, letters-only and numbers-only password.
Correct the values and continue.
cases.expect: Clear messages identify the problem. Correcting it works without creating duplicate schools.
cases.needs: Use a new unused inbox for a disposable registration.

cases.title: Prevent duplicate registration
steps: Try registering again with an email already registered.
Return to Sign in and use that account.
cases.expect: A duplicate account is not created. The existing account still works.

cases.title: Sign in with email and password
steps: Enter the assigned email and password.
Choose Sign in.
Check your name, school and available menu items.
Reload the page.
cases.expect: The correct school and permitted home open. Reload does not immediately sign you out.

cases.title: Reject a wrong password
steps: Try a wrong password once.
Try an unknown email once.
Enter your correct details.
cases.expect: Incorrect details do not open private records. Correct details still work.

cases.title: Choose between two schools
steps: Sign in with the shared test account.
Choose School A by name.
Sign out, sign in again and choose School B.
cases.expect: School names, menus and records match the chosen school. A wrong password must not reveal the school list.
cases.needs: Coordinator supplies one account belonging to both test schools.

cases.title: Sign in with Google
steps: Choose Continue with Google.
Select the assigned Google account.
Check your name and picture in Account.
Sign out and sign in again.
cases.expect: The intended account opens. Missing name/photo are filled from Google; existing saved details are preserved.
cases.needs: Coordinator has configured Google sign-in and provided a controlled Google account.

cases.title: Recover a forgotten password
steps: Choose Forgot password and enter your controlled email.
Open the reset message.
Set a new password and sign in.
Try the old password and reuse the reset link.
cases.expect: New password works. Old password and reused link fail. Do not copy the reset link into your report.
cases.needs: A working test inbox. Student passwords are reset through the school, not this email flow.

cases.title: Check unknown email recovery
steps: Open Forgot password.
Enter an unregistered test email.
Read the response.
cases.expect: The message does not disclose whether someone owns an account. It does not expose private details.

cases.title: Cancel Google sign-in
steps: Start Google sign-in.
Cancel the Google window.
Try ordinary sign-in again.
cases.expect: Cancellation leaves you signed out with a usable page; another account is not silently selected.

cases.title: Sign out safely
steps: Open a private page.
Use your avatar menu to sign out.
Press browser Back and reload.
cases.expect: Private records cannot be used as a signed-in session after sign-out.
cases.needs: Save all reports and synchronise pending work first.

cases.title: Keep separate accounts separate
steps: Tester A signs in and opens their records.
Sign out and let Tester B sign in using the same browser.
Check the school name, children and records.
cases.expect: Tester B never receives Tester A's private records or queued work.
cases.needs: Use only controlled accounts. Do not clear storage if work is waiting to sync.

cases.title: View a school public page
steps: Open the school public link supplied by the coordinator.
Read its school name, logo and contact information.
Choose its sign-in link.
cases.expect: Public school information is readable on phone/desktop and routes to the correct school. It does not reveal private pupils, balances or results.
cases.needs: Coordinator supplies the supported school public URL; no site-editing test is assumed.

title: Staff invitations and roles
roles: Owner; principal; school administrator; invited staff
needs: Controlled staff inboxes, a Google inbox, and sample-files staff email templates. Replace example emails before sending.

cases.title: Invite with only an email
steps: Open Staff and choose Invite staff.
Enter one controlled email and send.
Read the notification at the top of the screen.
Open Recent invitations.
cases.expect: An invitation is acknowledged once and appears in the list. Name, phone and role are not required; the default role is Teacher.

cases.title: Reject an invalid email
steps: Try an empty invitation and then an invalid email.
Correct it to a controlled email and send.
cases.expect: Helpful errors appear. The corrected invitation can be sent without restarting.

cases.title: Upload email invitations
steps: Open Upload staff spreadsheet.
Choose the prepared email-only file.
Review the checked rows and confirm.
Open Recent invitations.
cases.expect: Each valid address gets one invitation with Teacher as the initial role. The file does not need names.
cases.needs: Replace example.test addresses in the template with controlled inboxes.

cases.title: Check spreadsheet errors
steps: Upload staff-invalid.csv.
Read the row errors.
Upload staff-valid-template.csv after replacing its emails.
cases.expect: Bad email rows are identified. Nothing is sent until a valid upload is deliberately confirmed.

cases.title: Accept using a password
steps: Open the latest invitation while signed out.
Choose password registration and enter matching valid passwords.
Enter your first and last names when requested.
Finish and check the account name.
cases.expect: The invited email is correct, fields are usable, and the intended school opens with Teacher access.
cases.needs: A fresh controlled invitation. Never report the password or full invitation URL.

cases.title: Accept using Google
steps: Open an invitation sent to the assigned Google address.
Choose Google and use that same address.
Finish and check your profile.
cases.expect: The invitation is accepted for its recipient. Google supplies missing names/photo.
cases.needs: Google sign-in configured.

cases.title: Reject the wrong Google account
steps: Open a fresh invitation.
Choose a Google address different from the invitation recipient.
Return and use the invited account.
cases.expect: The wrong address cannot claim the invitation; the correct one can.
cases.needs: Two controlled Google accounts.

cases.title: Accept while the owner is already signed in
steps: Keep the owner signed in in one browser.
Open another person's invitation in that browser.
Check the displayed recipient before continuing.
Complete acceptance only using the intended recipient's sign-in details.
cases.expect: The invitation never becomes the owner's account. The correct recipient is clearly identified and usable.
cases.needs: Use a disposable invite and controlled recipient.

cases.title: Use an existing account
steps: Invite a controlled existing account to School B.
Open the invitation and follow the existing-account option.
Use that person's current password or matching Google account.
Sign in to both schools.
cases.expect: Both school memberships work. Acceptance does not silently replace the existing password or profile.

cases.title: Change a pending role
steps: Find a pending invitation.
Change the offered role to Bursar using the role control.
Accept the invitation with that recipient.
cases.expect: The account receives the saved permitted role. A principal must not grant owner or finance access.

cases.title: Add more than one role
steps: Open a teacher's roles.
Add Exam officer and save.
Have that teacher sign in again.
cases.expect: Teacher tools remain; Result progress and Exam timetable are added. Removing Exam officer removes those additional tools.
cases.needs: A teacher test account; keep a record of its original roles.

cases.title: Combine teaching and accounts work
steps: Add Bursar to a teacher test account.
Sign in as the teacher and open Fees and payments.
Confirm My classes and score entry still work.
Remove the added role after checking.
cases.expect: The account has the combined features without switching identities. Permission removal takes effect on the next live access check.

cases.title: Revoke and replace an invitation
steps: Revoke a pending invitation.
Try its old link.
Send a replacement and accept the new link.
cases.expect: Revoked and superseded links fail. The newest valid invitation works.

cases.title: Try used or expired invitations
steps: Reopen an invitation already accepted.
Open an expired invitation supplied by the coordinator.
cases.expect: Neither creates extra membership. A clear message explains the next step.
cases.needs: Coordinator supplies expired test invitation; otherwise mark Cannot test.

cases.title: Check staff tabs and own record
cases.role: Manager then teacher and general staff
steps: As manager, open each staff-type tab and Recent invitations.
As teacher or general staff, open My details from your account menu.
Look for editing of other people.
cases.expect: Managers see the correct group per tab. Other staff see only their own details and cannot edit the staff directory.

cases.title: Disable and restore a staff account
steps: Disable the disposable staff member's school access.
Ask them to refresh an online private page.
Re-enable access and have them sign in.
cases.expect: Disabled access is rejected online. Restored access works; verify teaching assignments rather than assuming they return.
cases.needs: Do not disable the tester conducting the test or the last owner.

title: School settings calendar and bank account
roles: Owner; principal; school administrator
needs: A disposable school, controlled owner inbox, sample school logo, and two terms with known dates. Coordinate changes with all testers.

cases.title: Review the owner home
steps: Open Home.
Check student, staff, parent, attendance, fees and results summaries.
Select each available summary card.
cases.expect: Figures match the prepared records. Cards lead to the relevant pages without offering the owner score-entry or attendance duties by default.

cases.title: Finish school setup
steps: Open the setup checklist.
Complete its requested calendar, class, subject, teacher, student and parent setup.
Reload Home after completion.
Sign out and sign in again.
cases.expect: The checklist is descriptive and compact. Once the school confirms completion, it stays hidden.
cases.needs: A new disposable school with incomplete setup.

cases.title: Save the school profile
steps: Open Settings then School profile.
Change a test contact field and save.
Reload and check it from another signed-in browser.
cases.expect: The saved value persists for this school only. A message confirms the save.

cases.title: Correct school profile errors
steps: Try an invalid contact email or a blank required name.
Read the message and correct it.
Save again.
cases.expect: Invalid values are rejected clearly. Other entered values are not unnecessarily lost.

cases.title: Use a logo and a long school name
steps: Save the supplied sample school logo and a long test school name.
Look at desktop sidebar, mobile navigation and login.
Restore the agreed test school name.
cases.expect: Logo and school name remain readable. A missing/broken logo uses a suitable SchoolOs fallback; long names do not overlap controls.

cases.title: Check school colours and device appearance
steps: Open Branding and review the offered green/gold controls.
Save an agreed test colour if permitted.
Switch the device between light and dark appearance.
Reload key pages.
cases.expect: The school-office palette remains readable in both device modes. Saved supported colour choices persist without changing another school.
cases.needs: Use only an agreed disposable branding change.

cases.title: Create a school year
steps: Open School year.
Create the agreed test year and its three terms.
Reload the page.
cases.expect: One school year and the intended terms are present; names are not duplicated.
cases.needs: Use a new year label supplied by the coordinator.

cases.title: Set term dates
steps: Edit a term and enter its agreed start and end dates.
Save and reload.
Try an end date before the start date.
cases.expect: Valid dates persist. Reversed dates are rejected and do not replace the saved dates.

cases.title: Choose the current term
steps: Set the agreed year and term as current.
Check the top term label, attendance and score selectors.
Reload.
cases.expect: The same current term is used consistently. Historical records are not moved into it.
cases.needs: Do not change the shared current term while other testers are saving work.

cases.title: Choose the marking structure
steps: Before entering any scores, open Settings then Academic.
Choose 20, 20, 60 and save.
Open a score sheet.
On a separate clean term, choose 15, 15, 70.
cases.expect: Score columns and allowed maximums match the selected structure.
cases.needs: Use clean terms with no scores. Restore the agreed baseline before shared testing.

cases.title: Protect a marking structure already in use
steps: Save a score in the current term.
Try changing that term to a different marking structure.
Reopen the original score.
cases.expect: The change is blocked with an explanation. Existing marks and their maximums remain correct.

cases.title: Start a receiving bank change
steps: Open Receiving bank account.
Enter the agreed test account and current password.
Choose Send verification code.
Check the masked recipient and inbox.
cases.expect: Only the creator can request the change. The proposed account is clearly shown; the old account stays active until verification.
cases.needs: Use an approved test bank account. Google-only owner may need to set a password first.

cases.title: Verify the exact bank account
steps: Check the proposed bank name, account name and number.
Enter the received 6-digit code and save.
Reload Settings and check the confirmation email.
cases.expect: The exact proposed account persists. Verification does not claim to prove ownership of the bank account.
cases.needs: Coordinate this test before any payment testing.

cases.title: Reject a wrong or expired bank code
steps: On a separate prepared request, enter one wrong code.
Wait until the code expires, then try it.
Check that the receiving account has not changed.
cases.expect: Wrong/expired codes fail. The old account remains unchanged.
cases.needs: Code expires after 10 minutes; five wrong attempts invalidate it. Use a disposable request.

cases.title: Prevent casual bank changes
cases.role: Original creator then principal and bursar
steps: After a successful bank update, try another update within 24 hours.
As principal and bursar, look for bank-edit controls.
Try the Settings address supplied by the coordinator.
cases.expect: The 24-hour restriction is explained. Other roles cannot change receiving bank details.
cases.needs: Run after the planned bank setup so it does not block the main payment test.

cases.title: Open help and account settings
steps: Open Help.
Use the avatar menu to open Account.
Check that your own details are shown.
cases.expect: Help is easy to find. Account settings refer to the signed-in person, not another user.

title: Classes subjects and teaching assignments
roles: Owner; principal; school administrator; teacher
needs: Three classes, Mathematics and English, a teacher and an unassigned teacher. Use disposable subjects/classes for removal.

cases.title: Create and edit a class
steps: Open Classes or Class management.
Add a class with its name, arm and level.
Edit its name, save and reload.
cases.expect: The correct class changes. Existing students remain attached to the same class record.

cases.title: Find a class in a long list
steps: Open the class list and search for a known class.
Use available filters.
Scroll a long list using mouse and phone.
cases.expect: The correct classes appear. Scrolling works with a thin themed scrollbar where needed; controls do not disappear.

cases.title: Reject a duplicate class
steps: Try adding the same class name and arm twice.
Correct one field and try again.
cases.expect: The duplicate is rejected clearly. A genuinely different class can be created.

cases.title: Create and edit a subject
steps: Open Subjects and add a disposable subject.
Click its pencil button.
Change the name or code, save and reload.
cases.expect: A clear edit form opens and only that subject changes.

cases.title: Confirm subject deletion
steps: Click the delete icon for an unused subject.
Cancel first.
Repeat and confirm only for the disposable subject.
cases.expect: Cancel changes nothing. Confirmation names the subject; successful removal is reflected after reload.

cases.title: Protect a subject with history
steps: Try removing a subject already used in a released test result.
Read the warning or error.
Check that the old report still makes sense.
cases.expect: Historical records are not silently lost or corrupted. Record the exact outcome if removal is prevented.
cases.needs: Do not confirm removal of a real or shared subject.

cases.title: Assign subjects to a class
steps: Open a class and its Subjects section.
Select Mathematics and English and save.
Reload the class.
cases.expect: Both subjects belong to that class and other classes are unchanged.

cases.title: Change a class curriculum
steps: On a disposable class, remove an unused subject assignment.
Save and reload.
Review its teaching assignments.
cases.expect: The intended curriculum change persists; removed assignments are not shown as active.
cases.needs: Avoid subjects with marks during this test.

cases.title: Assign a class teacher
steps: Open the class teacher control.
Choose the test teacher by name and save.
Reload and have that teacher open Attendance.
cases.expect: The class appears for that class teacher without copying any technical identifier.

cases.title: Handle more than one class assignment
steps: Assign the test teacher as class teacher to a second test class.
Sign in as that teacher and open Attendance.
Choose between the assigned classes.
cases.expect: Each assigned class can be selected. The single-class teacher experience remains simpler.
cases.needs: Use a separate teacher so other attendance testers are not interrupted.

cases.title: Assign and clear a subject teacher
steps: Choose Mathematics in a class and assign the test teacher.
Save and reload.
Clear the assignment and save on the disposable class.
cases.expect: Saved and cleared states persist. An unrelated subject assignment is not changed.

cases.title: View My classes as a teacher
steps: Open My classes.
Read each class card.
Open a subject card and use Mark attendance where offered.
cases.expect: Cards show class, subject and student count. Score entry opens the matching class/subject; attendance appears only for a class-teacher assignment.

cases.title: Prevent access to an unassigned class
steps: Open a class assigned to another teacher using the coordinator's link.
Try opening its score sheet and attendance.
cases.expect: Private teaching work is unavailable unless the tester has the necessary assignment or an additional authorised role.
cases.needs: Use only the second prepared test class.

cases.title: Deactivate a disposable class
steps: Open an unused test class.
Use the offered deactivate control and confirm.
Check active and inactive lists.
cases.expect: The class is no longer offered as active. Existing school history is not erased.

title: Student records upload and activation
roles: Owner; principal; school administrator
needs: Six baseline students, an unassigned student, an unused student for activation, and sample-files student CSV files. Pause shared fee tests while adding students.

cases.title: View student statistics before the list
steps: Open Students.
Read the student summary.
Select a class and then Without a class.
cases.expect: Statistics appear immediately. Students are listed only after a class/unassigned choice; each list contains the matching students.

cases.title: Search and page through students
steps: Select the disposable class containing 30 test students.
Search a known name or admission number.
Clear search and use Next, Previous and page-size controls.
cases.expect: Default pages contain 25 students at most. No student is skipped or repeated between pages.
cases.needs: Import students-pagination-30.csv into a separate disposable class first.

cases.title: Add a student using a form
steps: Choose Add student.
Enter first and last names; leave optional fields blank.
Save and reopen the student.
cases.expect: The record persists, with an admission number generated if omitted. A class is optional.

cases.title: Edit through the student menu
steps: Open the last student's action menu in a scrolled list.
Choose Edit student details.
Change a harmless field and save.
Repeat on a phone.
cases.expect: Every menu item is visible and clickable. The popup stays inside the screen and above the list.

cases.title: Upload names without a class
steps: Open Upload students.
Choose students-names-only.csv.
Read the automatically checked preview and confirm.
Open Without a class.
cases.expect: The students appear without a class. Admission numbers are generated; a school year is not required.
cases.needs: Use an untouched disposable school or rename sample people to avoid confusion.

cases.title: Upload directly into a class
steps: Select the disposable class before opening Upload students, or select it on the upload page.
Choose students-names-only.csv.
Confirm the preview.
cases.expect: The chosen class is used. The successful flow is class choice if needed, file selection and one confirmation; no separate Check button.

cases.title: Upload different classes in one file
steps: Prepare students-with-classes.csv with exact existing class names and arms.
Upload and confirm.
Check each affected class and Without a class.
cases.expect: Each row uses its intended class; blank-class rows remain unassigned. Unknown class names are reported before saving.

cases.title: Catch bad or duplicate rows
steps: Upload students-invalid.csv.
Read the row-specific errors.
Try a file containing an existing admission number.
Correct the file and upload again.
cases.expect: Invalid rows and duplicate admission numbers are explained. No partial import is described as a complete success.

cases.title: Keep leading zeros
steps: Use a spreadsheet with admission number 000123 stored as Text.
Upload and confirm.
Search for 000123.
cases.expect: Leading zeros remain intact. Excel/CSV formatting is explained where needed.

cases.title: Recover an interrupted upload
steps: In a separate prepared test session, confirm a small upload while the coordinator interrupts the connection.
Reconnect and use Retry saved upload.
Count the added students.
cases.expect: The saved attempt is confirmed once, without duplicate students.
cases.needs: Coordinator controls the interruption. Do not deliberately start a different upload as a retry.

cases.title: Observe the student limit
steps: Use the coordinator's near-limit school.
Upload more students than available spaces.
Read the preview and try to confirm only if enabled.
cases.expect: The available limit and failure are clear; too many students are not partly imported.
cases.needs: A disposable school close to its configured student limit.

cases.title: Issue a student activation code
steps: Open Student access for a new active student.
Choose New student and Create activation code.
Copy the private details and give them to that assigned tester.
cases.expect: All active students are eligible without a separate enable step. A private code and school-specific link are provided.
cases.needs: Do not put the code or password in a report.

cases.title: Use an activation code once
steps: Open the supplied student link.
Enter admission number, code and a chosen valid password.
Sign out and try the same code again.
cases.expect: The first activation creates the correct student account. Reuse fails, but normal sign-in with the chosen password works.

cases.title: Replace an activation code
steps: Issue a code for another unused student.
Issue a second code.
Try the first code, then activate with the second.
cases.expect: Only the newest code works. An expired code also fails when the coordinator supplies one.
cases.needs: Expiry is seven days; do not change device clocks to simulate it.

cases.title: Reset and disable student access
steps: Reset a disposable student's password and share it privately.
Check the old password and previous online session.
Disable the student and try signing in.
Use Reset password to restore access if needed.
cases.expect: Old credentials stop working online. Disabled access is blocked. Restored credentials work.
cases.needs: Use a disposable account; offline saved records cannot be erased remotely.

title: Parent records and child linking
roles: Owner; principal; school administrator; parent; student
needs: Parent A linked to Ada and John; Parent B linked only to Mary; a parent with no children; one student awaiting a parent link.

cases.title: View parent summaries first
steps: Open Parents.
Read the statistics before requesting a list.
Choose the offered class/search/list action.
cases.expect: Summary figures appear first. Parent records are not all displayed automatically.

cases.title: Add and edit a parent
steps: Add a parent with the controlled contact details.
Save and edit a harmless field.
Reload.
cases.expect: The intended parent record persists; an invalid email is rejected clearly.

cases.title: Link two children to one parent
steps: Open Parent A.
Link Ada and John using the named student choices.
Reload and sign in as Parent A.
cases.expect: Both intended children appear. Other families' children do not appear.

cases.title: Invite an existing parent record
steps: Send a login invitation from the prepared parent record.
Accept it using the invited controlled inbox.
Open My children.
cases.expect: The login connects to that parent record and its children; no duplicate unrelated family is created.

cases.title: Request a missing child by name
steps: Open Link a child.
Enter the prepared child's name, class if known and a short note.
Send and review the request.
cases.expect: The request is shown as awaiting school review. The child is not linked automatically.
cases.needs: Use the unlinked prepared child, not a real unknown child.

cases.title: Avoid duplicate child requests
steps: Send the same child name again with different spacing or letter case.
Review request history.
cases.expect: The repeated request is not treated as another independent pending child link.

cases.title: Approve a verified child request
steps: Open the parent child-link requests.
Verify the prepared relationship and select the correct student.
Approve and ask the parent to refresh.
cases.expect: Only the approved child is added. Existing child links remain intact.
cases.needs: Coordinator confirms the test relationship before approval.

cases.title: Decline a child request clearly
steps: Open a disposable incorrect request.
Decline with a brief explanation.
Have the parent check its status.
cases.expect: The request is declined with the explanation. No child access is granted.

cases.title: Review a student parent-email request
steps: As student, request the controlled parent email in Settings.
As manager, open Student parent requests.
Verify the relationship and approve with the parent's names.
cases.expect: A parent record is linked only after approval. The school sends a separate parent login invitation if required.
cases.needs: A controlled email and a student without that existing parent link.

cases.title: Preserve existing guardians
steps: Approve an additional verified parent for a child already linked to Parent A.
Check the child's parent records and Parent A's access.
cases.expect: The new link does not silently remove the existing guardian or replace the primary guardian.

cases.title: Unlink a disposable parent connection
steps: Remove only the disposable test child-parent link.
Reload both accounts online.
cases.expect: The removed child is no longer available to that parent. Other child links continue to work.
cases.needs: Do not remove the only guardian from real records.

title: Teacher attendance and school summaries
roles: Class teacher; subject-only teacher; owner; principal; school administrator
needs: An assigned class with known students, a subject-only teacher, and a current term with start/end dates.

cases.title: Open the assigned class roll
steps: Open Attendance.
Check the class and date.
Look for a class selector if only one class is assigned.
cases.expect: The one assigned class opens simply. A multi-class teacher can choose only their assigned class-teacher classes.

cases.title: Mark present and absent
steps: Mark Ada Present and John Absent.
Save attendance.
Reload the same class and date.
cases.expect: The two marks persist for the correct date. Other students are not silently marked present.

cases.title: Use lateness only when wanted
steps: Open the roll with Track lateness off.
Turn Track lateness on and mark one student Late.
Save, reload and turn tracking off.
cases.expect: Present/Absent are the main choices. Saved Late marks remain visible and count as present, even when the optional control is off.

cases.title: Excuse an absence
steps: Mark a student Absent.
Tick Excused absence, save and reload.
Change the student to Present.
cases.expect: Excused is offered only for an absent student. Present clears the absence; excused absences count as absent in summaries.

cases.title: Search the roll without losing work
steps: Mark one student.
Search a different student by part of their name and mark them.
Save and clear search.
cases.expect: Both marks are retained. Counts and saving cover the full class, not just the filtered names.

cases.title: Handle unmarked students
steps: Leave one student without a mark.
Save only the students intentionally marked.
Reload.
cases.expect: The untouched student remains unmarked. The page explains incomplete marking without inventing attendance.

cases.title: Correct a saved mark
steps: Change an earlier saved Absent mark to Present.
Save and reload.
Check the school summary for the same date.
cases.expect: The correction replaces the earlier mark instead of adding another attendance record.

cases.title: Choose a past or boundary date
steps: Open the first day of the prepared term and save a test roll.
Open the last day.
Try a date outside the term.
cases.expect: The selected dates are clear. Term summaries use the agreed term dates; unsupported dates are explained and do not silently enter the wrong term.
cases.needs: Coordinator supplies exact valid and outside dates.

cases.title: Keep attendance separate from subject teaching
steps: Open Attendance without a class-teacher assignment.
Try the coordinator's link to another class.
cases.expect: The account cannot mark attendance simply because it teaches a subject. A useful assignment message is shown.

cases.title: Show summaries for school leaders
cases.role: Owner then principal and school administrator
steps: Open Attendance.
Switch Day, Week and Term.
Check prepared totals and class summaries.
cases.expect: Leaders see summary views and do not mark rolls unless also assigned as class teachers. Late counts as present; excused counts as absent.

cases.title: Save attendance offline
steps: Download the workspace while online.
Disconnect using the coordinator's instructions.
Mark attendance and save.
Reconnect and check the saved marks from a second account.
cases.expect: The offline save is clearly labelled. Marks reach the server once after permission checks.
cases.needs: Use packet 16 to prepare the installed web app.

cases.title: Read an absence report
steps: Open any offered absent-student list for the test date.
Find the excused student and the late student.
cases.expect: Excused absences may be listed as absent with their status. Late students are not listed as absent.
cases.needs: If no absence-list control is offered, record Cannot test rather than inventing a route.

title: Score entry and marking structure
roles: Assigned subject teacher; teacher with additional roles
needs: Assigned Mathematics class, two terms, known students John Doe, Sarah Joshua and Mary Jo, and a clean 20/20/60 score sheet.

cases.title: Open the right score sheet
steps: Open My classes and a Mathematics card.
Select the school year/term if needed.
Check the class, subject and student names.
cases.expect: The correct class/subject/term opens. Only permitted teaching choices are offered.

cases.title: Save and reload valid scores

cases.title: Save edits hidden by search

cases.title: Keep a draft after leaving the page

cases.title: Enter scores comfortably on phone and desktop

cases.title: Protect another teacher's subject
steps: Use the coordinator's link to an unassigned subject sheet.

cases.title: Respect locked results

Reload the saved page, reconnect and check from another account.

cases.title: Handle a conflicting second editor

cases.title: Read result progress

Choose the agreed term and class.
Compare progress with the prepared submitted scores.

cases.title: Keep the owner focused on review
steps: Open Results from Home and the sidebar.
Look for the next review or publish action.

cases.title: Review an individual report
steps: Open the prepared student report.
Check name, admission number, class, term and subject totals.
Compare with the score sheet.
cases.expect: Report identity and calculations match the chosen student and term.

cases.title: Handle approval controls
steps: Open a report awaiting approval.
Use an offered approve/return control and confirm.
Reload the report.

cases.title: Confirm before releasing results
steps: Choose Publish for parents.
Read the term/class information.
Cancel before confirming.
cases.expect: The dialog explains what will become visible. Cancel leaves family visibility unchanged.

cases.title: Release an approved report
steps: Publish the agreed approved class report.
Sign in as its linked parent and then its student.
Open Results and reload.

cases.title: Keep incomplete reports distinguishable

cases.title: Manage an already released report

cases.title: Print a report on A4

Choose Print or Save result PDF.

Save a copy.

cases.title: Print both marking structures
steps: Open the prepared 20/20/60 report and print preview.
Repeat with the separate 15/15/70 term report.
cases.expect: Column maximums and scores match each report's own term, not the current default.

cases.title: Check a long report
steps: Open a report with many subjects and a long name/comment.
Print preview every A4 page.
cases.expect: Rows, repeated table headers and comments remain readable. A long school name does not hide student details.

cases.title: Save and print a report offline
steps: Download the workspace/report while online.
Disconnect and reopen the released result.
Use Print or Save result PDF.
cases.expect: The prepared result and full print document are available offline. A never-downloaded report does not falsely appear complete.

cases.title: Keep another child's report private
steps: Use a report link supplied for Parent A's child.

cases.expect: No foreign child's private result is shown.

cases.title: Start a timetable from subjects
steps: Open Exam timetable for the clean term.
Choose Exam.
Review the generated example before saving.

cases.title: Set three papers each day
steps: Set 3 papers per day, 2 hours per paper, starting 08:00.

Generate the 13-subject class example.

cases.title: Set four papers with grouped breaks

cases.title: Check subject completeness

cases.title: Move a paper on desktop
steps: Drag a paper to another valid slot.

cases.title: Move a paper on a phone
steps: Open the draft on a phone.

Save and reload.

cases.title: Create class groups
steps: Create a Junior group with JSS 1 and JSS 2.

Review each group's subjects and format.

cases.title: Exclude an exam class
steps: Create a group that excludes the prepared exam class.

cases.title: Use separate group formats

cases.title: Merge and print a timetable

Download or print on A4.
cases.expect: The combined view clearly identifies the relevant groups. Print pages are readable and do not crop paper times.

cases.title: Keep exam and test plans separate
steps: Save an Exam draft.

Return to Exam.
cases.expect: Exam and Test drafts remain separate for the chosen term.

cases.title: Reject invalid timetable settings

cases.expect: Only published and relevant class/group information appears. Readers cannot edit the plan.

cases.title: Withdraw a timetable
steps: Use Unpublish/withdraw on a disposable published plan.

cases.expect: The live published plan is no longer available. Previously downloaded offline copies are not claimed to be remotely erased.

cases.title: Handle concurrent timetable editing
steps: Open the same draft in two browsers.

cases.expect: The older edit is rejected or clearly reconciled; no unnoticed replacement is reported as success.

cases.expect: A clear edit form opens only when requested. Saved changes and affected totals agree; paid history is not silently rewritten.

cases.title: Correct invalid fee values
steps: Try blank item name, zero, a negative amount and decimal naira separately.

cases.title: Prevent accidental duplicate billing

cases.title: Handle a class move

cases.title: Keep old terms separate

cases.title: Keep principals out of school accounts

title: Bursar payments receipts and reports

cases.title: Review debtors paid students and credits

cases.title: Download and print accounts reports

cases.title: Read and print released results

Open it and return to the list.
Reload or reopen the account menu.
cases.expect: Unread count decreases for this user only. Reading one notice does not mark unrelated notices read.

cases.title: Keep another user's unread status
steps: Have Reader A open a new notice.
Sign in as Reader B who has not opened it.
Check the badge.
cases.expect: Reader B still sees that notice as unread.

cases.title: Confirm notice deletion
steps: Delete a disposable draft or test notice.
Cancel first, then confirm the disposable deletion.
Refresh the reader list.
cases.expect: Cancel changes nothing. Confirmed deletion affects only the selected notice and does not leave a broken detail page.

cases.title: Separate email delivery from posting
steps: Publish a notice with an offered email notification option.
Check both the board and the controlled mailbox.
Record delivery time.
cases.expect: Posting and email delivery are distinguishable. A queued email is not described as delivered.
cases.needs: If no email option exists in the UI, record Cannot test; the coordinator handles delivery checks.

cases.title: Read a notice offline
steps: Download or open the published notice while online.
Disconnect and read it again.
Reconnect and check its read indicator.
cases.expect: The saved notice is readable. Read tracking syncs without changing anyone else's status.

title: Offline use installation and recovery
roles: Teacher; bursar; parent; student; coordinator
needs: Use a deployed HTTPS production version, or the coordinator's prepared localhost production build. Use only one account/device per offline run and keep work saved.

cases.title: Install the offline web app
steps: While online, find Download offline version or Install app.
Follow the browser prompt.
Open SchoolOs from its new home-screen/desktop icon.
cases.expect: The installed app opens the same permitted school workspace. If installation is unavailable, instructions explain the supported browser path.
cases.needs: An installable production build. Ordinary development mode is not a full offline-install test.

cases.title: Prepare your workspace
steps: While online, use Download workspace/offline preparation.
Wait for the completed message.
Open the required class, report or fee records once.
cases.expect: Preparation confirms what was saved. Failed or unavailable parts are not called complete.

cases.title: Keep working when the school server stops
steps: Keep the device connected to the internet.
Have the coordinator stop only the test backend.
Reload an already prepared protected page.
cases.expect: Saved authorised pages still open. An access-check warning does not unnecessarily block records just because the backend is unavailable.
cases.needs: Coordinator handles the test server; tester does not edit settings or run commands.

cases.title: Reopen while fully disconnected
steps: Close only the prepared app window.
Turn off Wi-Fi/mobile data or enable flight mode.
Reopen the installed SchoolOs app.
Open previously downloaded records.
cases.expect: The saved app opens without contacting the server. Prepared data and the current account identity remain available.

cases.title: Use it after two days offline
steps: Prepare the workspace and record date/time.
Stay disconnected for at least 48 hours without signing out or clearing data.
Reopen the same installed app and prepared records.
cases.expect: Prepared records remain useful after two days while the offline authorisation remains valid. Record actual start/end times; do not simulate this by changing the clock.
cases.needs: Coordinator confirms the account and offline access period will remain valid.

cases.title: Queue attendance safely
steps: Disconnect after preparing a class.
Mark and save attendance.
Close/reopen the app and check the same date.
Reconnect and wait for the sync result.
cases.expect: Marks survive reopening and sync once. Other students are not silently marked present.

cases.title: Queue score changes safely
steps: Disconnect with a prepared score sheet.
Edit two students and choose Save scores.
Reopen the same sheet, then reconnect.
Check the server copy with the coordinator.
cases.expect: Draft/queued marks survive and reach the school once, with the correct term/class/subject.

cases.title: Queue a manual cash payment
steps: Disconnect after downloading Fees.
Record the approved manual test payment.
Reopen Saved payments.
Reconnect and compare the confirmed receipt.
cases.expect: Money is shown as pending until confirmed. Reconnect does not create a second payment.
cases.needs: Use a unique disposable reference; do not run a real card payment offline.

cases.title: Queue a parent-link request
steps: Disconnect with the relevant prepared request page.
Send the prepared child-name or parent-email request.
Reopen and reconnect.
cases.expect: The request is retained and later sent once. Offline sending never approves family access automatically.

cases.title: Read results and receipts offline
steps: Prepare a released result and a confirmed receipt.
Disconnect and open both.
Open print preview for the prepared report.
cases.expect: Saved documents are readable and printable where downloaded. A missing copy gets clear guidance, not invented data.

cases.title: Handle a page never downloaded
steps: While offline, open a permitted page or record not downloaded before.
Return to a prepared page.
cases.expect: The app explains what is missing. It does not crash, invent records or force all saved pages to stop working.

cases.title: Keep online-only actions honest
steps: While disconnected, try sign-up or password change and a payment checkout.
Read the response and return to saved records.
cases.expect: A connection requirement is clear. No password change, activation, bank verification or online payment is falsely confirmed.

cases.title: Sync after the connection returns
steps: Restore internet and the test backend.
Use the shown sync/retry action if needed.
Check the record from a second online account.
cases.expect: The pending count clears only after confirmation. The final record and totals match the intended single change.

cases.title: Protect against changed permissions at sync
steps: Prepare and queue one harmless test edit while offline.
Have the coordinator remove that account's relevant permission online.
Reconnect and sync.
cases.expect: The server rejects unauthorised work with a clear message. The app does not pretend it uploaded successfully or silently discard the only copy.
cases.needs: Use a separate disposable account; restore its access after the test.

cases.title: Protect another school's saved data
steps: Finish/sync work and sign out.
Sign in to School B on the same device.
Disconnect and open School B's saved pages.
cases.expect: School A's records and queued changes are not shown as School B's data.
cases.needs: Never switch account with unreported unsynchronised work.

cases.title: Show offline status clearly
steps: Disconnect on desktop and phone.
Open the sidebar, bottom navigation and a save action.
Read the offline notice.
cases.expect: The notice is visible above navigation and does not cover essential controls. It says whether data is saved locally or confirmed by the school.

cases.title: Update the installed app safely
steps: Save and sync work.
Have the coordinator publish an approved test frontend update.
Reopen online and use the update/reload prompt.
Check saved records.
cases.expect: Update guidance is clear. A normal update does not silently erase pending work or show another account's data.
cases.needs: Do not clear browser/app storage as a routine update step.

cases.title: Sign out while offline deliberately
steps: Make sure no important work is pending.
Disconnect and choose Sign out.
Reopen the app.
cases.expect: Local signed-in access ends. The app does not promise immediate server revocation while disconnected.
cases.needs: Run last on a disposable prepared account; signing out can remove offline access.

cases.title: Queue ordinary school record changes
steps: Prepare a disposable student, parent, class and subject while online.
Disconnect and make one harmless permitted edit in each available screen.
Reconnect and compare the records from a second browser.
cases.expect: Supported changes are clearly pending and reach the correct school once. Unsupported actions ask for connection instead of pretending to save.
cases.needs: Use a separate disposable dataset, not the shared fee baseline.

cases.title: Queue a draft notice or fee setup
steps: Prepare a disposable draft notice and unpaid fee rule online.
Disconnect and make a harmless edit in each supported screen.
Reconnect and review the final saved versions.
cases.expect: Pending changes are labelled. Family-visible money/notices do not get described as confirmed before the school accepts the changes.

cases.title: Queue an exam draft carefully
steps: Download the prepared exam draft online.
Disconnect, move one paper and save.
Reconnect and open the server copy.
cases.expect: Supported draft changes sync correctly or show a clear conflict. A local draft is not misrepresented as already published to families.

title: Role permissions and school privacy
roles: One tester per role; coordinator pairs school accounts
needs: Separate test logins for owner, administrator, principal, teacher, exam officer, bursar, general staff, parent, student and platform roles. Coordinator supplies safe test page links.

cases.title: Owner access
steps: Open Home, Students, Parents, Classes, Staff, Results, Attendance, Fees, Notices and Settings.
Check the school name on each.
cases.expect: The owner can manage the school. Attendance/results are oversight views unless teaching assignments also exist.

cases.title: School administrator access
steps: Open school management features and financial pages offered to this account.
Open Attendance and score entry without a teaching assignment.
cases.expect: Authorised school administration works. It does not automatically grant class-teacher attendance or unassigned subject score entry.

cases.title: Principal academic access
steps: Open academic summaries, classes, staff, results and exam timetable.
Try the provided Fees and record-payment links.
Check Home for financial totals.
cases.expect: Academic tools work. Finance data/actions and financial Home summaries are not available without an added finance role.

cases.title: Teacher assignment boundaries
steps: Open My classes, Attendance, Results and Announcements.
Try the coordinator's unassigned class and school-settings links.
cases.expect: Assigned work is accessible. Unassigned teaching work and school management stay unavailable; Today is not a required extra sidebar item.

cases.title: Exam officer access
steps: Open Result progress and Exam timetable.
Try attendance and unassigned score entry.
cases.expect: Exam coordination works. The title alone does not grant classroom attendance or unassigned subject entry.

cases.title: Bursar access
steps: Open Fees and payments and the offered notices.
Try class management, score entry and receiving-bank settings.
cases.expect: Accounts work is available. Unassigned academic entry and creator-only bank changes are blocked.

cases.title: General staff access
steps: Open Announcements and My details.
Look for staff-directory edit controls.
Try the provided score-entry and fee-management links.
cases.expect: General staff cannot edit other staff, enter unassigned scores or manage school money. Empty assigned-work views are explained.

cases.title: Parent privacy
steps: Open your linked child.
Use the supplied link for Parent A's child, receipt and result.
Try a staff page.
cases.expect: Only the parent's linked children are accessible. Staff work and other families' private records are blocked.

cases.title: Student privacy
steps: Open your Results and Fees.
Use the supplied link for another student's report or receipt.
Try the parent review queue and staff pages.
cases.expect: Only own released reports and bills are available. A student cannot review their own parent-link request.

cases.title: Combine and remove roles
cases.role: Teacher with Exam officer and Bursar roles
steps: Check the combined sidebar.
Open teaching, result-progress, timetable and fee tools.
Have the manager remove the added roles and refresh online.
cases.expect: Features are combined in one account, without duplicates. Removed permissions stop working on live access checks.

cases.title: Typing a forbidden page address
steps: While signed in, paste the coordinator's forbidden page link into the address bar.
Reload and try browser Back.
cases.expect: Private unauthorised content is not exposed simply by typing a URL.
cases.needs: Coordinator supplies exact test links; do not guess real student IDs.

cases.title: Protect School B records
steps: Open a private School B class/report/receipt link supplied by the coordinator.
Try the same address after reload.
cases.expect: No School B private records are disclosed under School A's account.
cases.needs: Use the two controlled schools only.

cases.title: Reject a removed membership online
steps: Sign in and open a private page.
Have the coordinator remove that school membership.
Refresh online.
cases.expect: Further online access is rejected. The page does not treat a recent successful login as permanent permission.
cases.needs: Offline saved copies are governed separately; use packet 16 for that scenario.

cases.title: Keep stale tabs safe
steps: Open Account A in two tabs.
Sign out in one and sign in as Account B.
Use the old tab to refresh or attempt a harmless save.
cases.expect: It updates to the correct context or rejects the stale action. It must not save under the wrong person/school.
cases.needs: No important pending work should exist before this test.

cases.title: Handle an account with no school access
steps: Try signing in with the controlled account that has no active school membership.
Read the response.
cases.expect: No school dashboard or private records open. Guidance explains contacting the school.

cases.title: Protect creator-only controls
cases.role: Co-owner or administrator who did not create the school
steps: Open Settings and try the supplied receiving-account address.
Attempt a bank change only if the page incorrectly offers it.
cases.expect: Only the original creator can change the receiving bank account, even if another person has broad school-management permissions.
cases.needs: Use a harmless test account; do not confirm a real bank change.

title: Mobile clarity appearance and accessibility
roles: Repeat with owner; teacher; bursar; parent; student
needs: A phone, desktop browser and tablet if available. Use real devices where possible; this packet evaluates usability, not only technical success.

cases.title: Understand each home without help
steps: Sign in and spend no more than one minute looking at Home.
Say what you can do next.
Find one important role-specific task.
cases.expect: The purpose and next action are clear without a demonstration. Record the time and any help needed.

cases.title: Use the phone navigation
steps: Open the bottom tabs and More menu.
Visit every permitted feature.
Return Home.
cases.expect: Icons have meaningful labels, active location is clear and nothing is hidden behind the bottom bar.

cases.title: Read on a small phone
steps: Open a class list, form, fees summary and notice on the smallest available phone.
Read without zooming.
Turn the phone sideways.
cases.expect: Text stays readable, buttons are easy to tap and content reflows. Only wide data tables need deliberate sideways scrolling.

cases.title: Use desktop space well
steps: Open dashboard, fees and reports on desktop.
Find the primary action and summary totals.
Compare with the phone version.
cases.expect: Desktop layouts use the space well without giant cards, empty stretches or an overwhelming wall of content.

cases.title: Use menus at the bottom of a list
steps: Scroll to the final student/class record.
Open its menu and each offered action.
Repeat on phone.
cases.expect: Menus and dialogs fit within the screen and every action is clickable.

cases.title: Navigate with the keyboard
steps: Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move through navigation and a form.
Use Enter/Space to activate controls.
Open a dialog and close it with Escape where safe.
cases.expect: Focus is visible, controls are labelled and focus does not get trapped behind the dialog.

cases.title: Read larger text
steps: Increase browser zoom/text size to 200 percent.
Open navigation, a form and fees.
Complete a harmless task.
cases.expect: Important labels and actions remain available without overlap or unreadable clipping.

cases.title: Understand status without colour
steps: Review attendance, payment and result-progress statuses.
Read the wording without relying on green/red/gold.
cases.expect: Status includes words or other clear indicators, not colour alone.

cases.title: Read errors and save confirmations
steps: Trigger one harmless required-field error.
Correct it and save a disposable change.
Read the confirmation.
cases.expect: Both messages explain what happened and the next step. A saved-on-device message is not confused with a confirmed school save.

cases.title: Inspect long names and empty screens
steps: Open a long school name, long student name and an empty permitted list.
Look for the next action.
cases.expect: Names do not overlap controls. Empty screens explain what is missing and offer a useful allowed next step.

cases.title: Check scrolling and sticky controls
steps: Scroll a long class list and open the sidebar.
Check that the top bar stays available.
Try the page on mobile.
cases.expect: Scrollbars are thin/themed where visible; sidebar scrolling remains usable. Sticky bars do not cover the content or offline notice.

cases.title: Give a frank overall rating
steps: Complete the four usability ratings at the end of this packet.
Name the hardest task.
Suggest one change that would help most.
cases.expect: Your answers reflect your actual experience. Beautiful appearance does not automatically mean the task was easy.

title: Platform administration readiness
roles: Platform administrator; super administrator; coordinator
needs: Platform-scoped test accounts and two disposable schools. This packet is separate from ordinary school testing; do not change a real subscription or disable a real school.

cases.title: Open the platform home
steps: Sign in with the platform test account.
Check the platform home and school summaries.
Open an offered metric.
cases.expect: Platform pages open for platform roles, not as a school owner's dashboard. Counts match the prepared schools.

cases.title: Find a school
steps: Open Schools.
Search and use the offered status filters.
Open School A and then School B.
cases.expect: Each school's identity/details are correct. Switching records does not leave the previous school's details displayed.

cases.title: Inspect school details
steps: Open a school's Overview, People and Academic tabs.
Compare with the coordinator's records.
Reload.
cases.expect: Each tab reflects that school and its real records; loading/empty errors are not disguised as working example data.

cases.title: Disable and restore a disposable school
steps: Disable only the agreed disposable school.
Ask its tester to refresh online.
Restore the school and sign in again.
cases.expect: Disabled schools reject online school access; restored access works. Other schools remain available.

cases.title: Change a disposable subscription
steps: Open the test school's plan/student-limit controls.
Set the coordinator-approved test limit and save.
Reload and ask the school tester to check the limit.
cases.expect: The saved limit persists and applies to student creation/imports without affecting another school.
cases.needs: Record the original subscription and restore it afterward.

cases.title: Review billing totals honestly
steps: Open Billing.
Compare every offered count/amount with the prepared subscriptions.
Reload.
cases.expect: Live values persist and agree with school subscription records. Static example rows or pretend saves must be reported, not accepted.

cases.title: Manage platform assignments
steps: Open Team and assign the prepared platform administrator where offered.
Reload and verify the intended assignment.
Remove only the disposable assignment.
cases.expect: Permitted assignments persist. Removal affects only the selected user/school scope.
cases.needs: Coordinator confirms which platform role can perform this action.

cases.title: Protect super administrator controls
steps: Open Team.
Look for platform-user creation or super-role actions.
Try only the supplied restricted page links.
cases.expect: Super-only actions are unavailable; ordinary platform access cannot create a super administrator.

cases.title: Check new school creation readiness
steps: Open the offered Add school screen.
Create only a uniquely named disposable test school if the coordinator approves.
Reload the school list and try its recorded login flow.
cases.expect: Success counts only if the school actually persists and is usable. A success animation alone is not a pass.
cases.needs: This screen needs a readiness check; do not assume every visible platform screen is connected.

cases.title: Check global settings readiness
steps: Change a harmless test support setting and save.
Reload and reopen from another browser.
Restore the original setting if saved.
cases.expect: A claimed save must persist across reload. If values reset or no real save exists, record Failed or Cannot test with details.
cases.needs: Do not alter PIN or other legacy settings for real users.

cases.title: Check legacy screens without relying on them
steps: Look for any remaining PIN card or public PIN result-checker links.
Open only the supplied disposable links.
Record which are visible and whether they are clearly unavailable.
cases.expect: Legacy or unfinished tools are not presented as required working SchoolOs features. Record visible stale links as a release issue.
cases.needs: Do not generate, sell or rely on PIN cards; student/parent accounts are the supported family route.

cases.title: Keep platform accounts separate from schools
steps: As owner, try the platform address supplied by the coordinator.
As platform user, confirm the intended school context before any action.
cases.expect: A school owner cannot enter platform administration just by using its address. Platform actions clearly identify their target school.

title: Complete school day with handoffs
roles: Coordinator pairs owner; teacher; exam officer; bursar; parent; student
needs: A fresh disposable school with the six-student baseline. Run in order after feature testing; record every handoff. Do not invent an approval or use the database to bypass a broken screen.

cases.title: Set up the school
steps: Create the test school.
Set the agreed year/term dates, classes, subjects and marking structure.
Invite and assign the test staff.
cases.expect: Staff can sign in with the correct combined permissions and teaching assignments.

cases.title: Bring in students and families
steps: Upload the six baseline students and confirm class placement.
Link Parent A to Ada and John and invite the parent.
Issue Ada's activation code.
cases.expect: The parent sees only their children; Ada can activate the simple student account.

cases.title: Set and check school fees
steps: Apply the junior, senior and Laboratory fees from packet 11.
Check all six students' bill totals.
Confirm expected income before any payment.
cases.expect: Expected is NGN 152200, received 0 and still owed 152200.

cases.title: Take attendance offline and confirm online
steps: Prepare the assigned class online.
Disconnect, mark attendance and save.
Reconnect; the owner checks the day summary.
cases.expect: The saved marks reach the correct class/date once and the owner summary agrees.

cases.title: Enter and review results
steps: Save the prepared subject marks.
Have the reviewer inspect progress and use the available review controls.
Prepare one approved report for release.
cases.expect: Each handoff is usable through the app. If approval cannot be completed in the UI, stop and record a blocked release test.

cases.title: Release and print the report
cases.role: Authorised publisher then parent and student
steps: Publish the approved test report.
Parent and student open it independently.
Save its A4 printout.
cases.expect: Both see the same released result. A different family and another student cannot access it.

cases.title: Pay and reconcile
steps: Complete one approved test payment for Ada, or record an agreed manual payment if provider testing is unavailable.
Have bursar and parent check the balance/receipt.
Compare school totals.
cases.expect: One payment changes totals once and both views agree. If checkout is unavailable, mark online-payment testing Cannot test separately.

cases.title: Publish the exam plan and notice
steps: Publish the test timetable and a related notice.
Teacher and parent open them.
Check the parent's class-specific timetable and unread notice indicator.
cases.expect: The right readers get the relevant published information without editing access.

cases.title: Check cross-school and role boundaries
steps: Use the agreed School B and other-family test links.
Try them under School A and Parent B.
Record any exposed name, score, receipt or action.
cases.expect: No unauthorised school/family record is disclosed. Any exposure stops release testing immediately.

cases.title: Close the run and agree next steps
steps: Save/download all reports and backups.
List failed and untested cases.
Assign owners and retest dates for each important problem.
Restore disposable changes as agreed.
cases.expect: Nothing untested is labelled passed. The coordinator can identify the remaining release blockers and who will retest them.

title: Own account name picture and password
roles: Repeat for staff; parent; student; platform account
needs: Own controlled test account, sample-school-logo.png for a harmless picture test, and invalid-picture.txt. Keep replacement passwords private.

cases.title: Find your account settings
steps: Open your name/avatar menu.
Choose Account or Settings.
Check the displayed person and available account actions.
cases.expect: The page belongs to you. Menu controls stay visible above the page, and sign out is easy to find.

cases.title: Change your displayed name
steps: Enter a new harmless first/last display name.
Save and reload.
Check the top bar and My details.
cases.expect: The saved name is used consistently. It does not change someone else's profile or the school-managed student academic identity.

cases.title: Reject an empty display name
steps: Try saving a blank first or last name.
Correct the field and save.
cases.expect: A clear error prevents a blank identity. The corrected name persists.

cases.title: Add a profile picture
steps: Choose the small sample PNG as your picture.
Save if requested.
Reload and check the avatar.
cases.expect: The picture is displayed neatly without stretching or breaking the menu.

cases.title: Remove a profile picture
steps: Use Remove picture.
Reload.
cases.expect: The old picture is removed and a readable initials/default avatar appears.

cases.title: Reject an unsuitable picture
steps: Try invalid-picture.txt and the coordinator's oversized test picture.
Read the message.
Choose the small PNG afterward.
cases.expect: Unsupported or oversized images fail clearly. A valid image can still be selected afterward.

cases.title: Change your password
steps: Enter the current password and a new valid matching password.
Save.
Sign in with the new password and test the old one once.
cases.expect: New password works; the old one fails. The page explains if it signs you out.
cases.needs: At least 8 characters including a letter and number; share changes privately with your coordinator.

cases.title: Reject a wrong current password
steps: Try a password change with an incorrect current password.
Sign in using the original correct password.
cases.expect: The change is rejected and the original credential remains valid.

cases.title: Reject weak or mismatched new passwords
steps: Try 7 characters, letters only, numbers only and different confirmation values separately.
Correct the form.
cases.expect: Each error is understandable and no password is changed accidentally.

cases.title: Set a password for a Google account
cases.role: Google user with no existing password
steps: Open your own account settings.
Use the offered reset/set-password path with your controlled email.
Complete the link and sign in.
cases.expect: The account can establish a password through a verified flow. Google access is not attached to another person.
cases.needs: Coordinator confirms Google/email setup and the intended account.

cases.title: Keep account actions honest offline
steps: Disconnect and open account settings.
Try changing the password or profile picture.
Return to a downloaded page.
cases.expect: The app does not falsely confirm live credential changes. The rest of the prepared workspace stays usable.
